name: web-builder
description: Project factory: discovers a product, gets its visual direction approved, writes and reviews complete specifications, generates an independent repository, validates it, and hands it off.
author: SkormJF
_scripts_note: Exactly three, matching the three mechanical scripts. The mechanical Spec Gate is deliberately not aliased here -- it is a helper inside scripts/lib/, invoked directly as `node scripts/lib/spec-gate.mjs`, and create-project runs it as a hard precondition. Giving it an npm alias would make it read as a fourth top-level script.
